uq13v2.description_en:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.
NO MORE.
Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.
In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of 500 UEC per outlaw dealt with.
Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!
* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

13o9de4.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = ME-01
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********
Maltrox Arlington has been keeping a low profile recently, but we think he's come out of hiding. A patrol was refueling at a station when one of their ships was boosted. Maltrox is the most likely suspect. While the regtag was temporarily deactivated, we have been able to trace the ship’s quantum signature and have provided you those coordinates.
A third generation criminal, the Arlington gang has been under Maltrox’s leadership for the past six years. Be aware, this is a smart, aggressive, and very dangerous target. The more resources you can bring to bear, the more likely it is that we can bring Maltrox in one and for all.
You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
13o9de4.description_zh:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 差事

合约类型：集体逮捕令
合约状态：独立
授权代码 = [CONTRACTOR]

需要立即处理

*********
__背景信息__
臭名昭著的阿灵顿帮居然试图从一个修船厂中盗窃一艘伊德里斯级护卫舰，作为回应，他们每个人都在这一份集体逮捕令中。这次盗窃被阻止了，那群渣滓落荒而逃，分开躲进了黑暗中。到底是无胆鼠辈，大难临头各自飞。埃克哈特安保收到了一份对阿灵顿帮高级成员的即时赏金逮捕令。成员包括：马尔特克斯·阿灵顿，卡斯·登特，尼克斯·坎特威尔，萨姆“爱哭鬼”阿灵顿，奥斯陆·阿灵顿和莱斯·阿灵顿。
*********

马尔特克斯·阿灵顿近来十分低调，但道高一丈，我们还是发现了他的蛛丝马迹并定位了一处可能是其藏身处的坐标。近日，一艘巡逻队舰船被盗窃，事发时该巡逻舰正随其所属巡逻队在一个燃料补给站补充燃料。马尔特克斯·阿灵顿是该案件最大的嫌疑人。该巡逻舰注册的可追踪标签被临时停用了，但通过分析并追踪舰船的量子特征，我们得出了该舰目前的坐标。

马尔特克斯·阿灵顿出生于一个犯罪之家。这个家族三代人都以犯罪为生。这六年来，马尔特克斯一直作为阿灵顿帮领袖活动着。当心。马尔特克斯是一个不好搞定的目标。他阴险，聪明，而且交战手段通常十分激进。此行动有很大可能会演变成一场持久战。带上你所能承担得起的一切补给，无论是弹药还是医用品，能带多少带多少。把马尔特克斯一劳永逸的干掉，给他的罪恶一生画上句号。

你被授权使用任何必要的火力，枪炮刀剑都无所谓，把他干掉。

报酬将于合约成功完成后发放。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

If you can pull this off, there's a nice paycheck in it for you.

4fbx7e.description_en:
Hey,
Need a reliable contractor to help us out with a bit of a situation.
Our of our haulers has dropped out mid-contract and now our client's cargo is stuck in transit. Think they were trying to negotiate a better rate with us, but that's not how Ling does business. Anyway, they're done and we desperately need the shipment finished.
Petra and I have been working with this client for years now and have built up a good rapport. Be a shame to throw that all a way because of an unreliable hauler. Can you head to [LOCATION] and collect the shipment? You'll need a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Take the shipment to the freight elevator over at [DESTINATION] and we'll get you paid as soon as. We'd really appreciate your help with this and I'm sure our client would too.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

佩特拉和我跟这客户合作好多年了，关系一直挺稳，真不想因为一个不靠谱的运输员全砸了。你能去 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 把货取走吗？记得带个<EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>，再开艘能装下 <EM4>[MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱</EM4>的船。

货送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 那边的货运电梯就行，我们马上结账。真挺感谢你搭把手的，客户肯定也一样！

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员

1keh90f.description_en:
One of our pilots was supposed to bring a shipment back to us, but seems like he got into some trouble over at [LOCATION]. Either he got his brains blasted all over the cockpit, or freaked out and ditched his ship. For his sake, I hope it’s the first one so I don’t have the hunt this asshole down. What’s important right now is that our cargo’s just sitting out there.
If you’ve got a heavy-duty tractor beam and a decent ship, can you head over there and get our stuff? Chances are the assholes who attacked my pilot are still there, and I’m betting they’re pretty tough.
If you get out alive, take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll get you paid.
Stows out.
1keh90f.description_zh:
我们的一名飞行员本应该把一批货带回，但看起来他在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 那儿出了点麻烦。要么他的脑袋被炸得满驾驶舱都是，要么吓得把船扔掉了。为了他着想，希望只是第一种情况，这样我就不用去追杀那个混蛋了。现在最重要的是，我们的货还在那儿。

如果你有<EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>和一艘不错的飞船，能过去把我们的货弄回来吗？袭击我飞行员的那些混蛋很可能还在那儿，而且他们肯定不好对付。

要是你能活着回来，把货送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的货运电梯那儿，我就给你报酬。

1pxsbe8.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Update:
The seismic data you extracted had some interesting revelations. My expert says she thinks that Jorrit might have been excavating down there. Hate to think what he’s doing, but it's our job to find out. I think we’re close to cracking this, so I want you to go back to Onyx and gather the Power Usage data. If we can track energy flow from the last couple months, a pattern should reveal itself.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Engineering wing and upload the Power Usage data.
Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.
Once you hand off this data, I'll be sending you 10 Secure Drives with copies of the information we've gathered so far. You can collect them at your home location.
1pxsbe8.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #JD10285
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件更新：
你提取的地震波数据里有一些有趣的发现。我的专家表示，她觉得乔里特可能在下面进行过挖掘。虽然不太想猜测他在干嘛，但搞清楚这是我们的任务。我觉得我们快找到答案了，所以我想让你返回玛瑙，收集能源用量数据。如果我们能追踪过去几个月的能源流动，应该就能发现一些规律。

合约调查员的行动：
探索<EM4>工程</EM4>翼楼并<EM4>上传能源用量数据</EM4>。

补充说明：
小心站点现场可能出现的敌对势力。

驾驶一辆可以停放在大型机库中的载具前往玛瑙设施。

一旦你交出这些数据，我会给你发送<EM4> 10 个 ASD 安全驱动器</EM4>，里面会有我们目前收集到的所有数据的副本。你可以在你的家园位置领取它们。

Just got a comm from the pilot who was transporting some gear for me and it sounded like they got jumped while on the call. I need someone to head to their location, grab the four packages that are still left inside their ship and bring them back to me.

在他们通讯中断之前，他们告诉我袭击他们的飞船不是普通的运输船。那些混蛋配备了非常厉害的武器。带上一个团队，把我的东西拿回来，然后送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。整个情况太混乱了，如果你们能完成这个任务，我愿意多付一些报酬。

7qcf56.description_en: An emergency SOS just came through from a maintenance crew under the employ of one of Foxwell's VIP clients. If available, we urge you to get to [LOCATION] as soon as possible. While engaging with the attackers, you'll be expected to protect the client’s [OBJECTS] and of their ships that may need assistance. This is far from the first we've seen from these particular outlaws, so believe me when I say these pilots are not to be taken lightly. I strongly recommend that you arrange a highly competent backup force to fly with you to the site. If you manage to successfully defend the client's interests, we’re offering 6 MG Scrip as compensation to the main contractor brave enough to take this job on. Stay safe, and good luck, Eugene Walton Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement 'Security, Your Way' Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
7qcf56.description_zh:
来自福克斯韦尔一位 VIP 客户旗下的维护团队发出了紧急求救信号。如有可能，请立即前往<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>。在应对袭击者时，你需要全力保护客户的 <EM4>[OBJECTS] 及其可能需要援助的飞船</EM4>。

这些不法分子此前已多次作案，相信我，绝不能轻视他们的飞行技术。我强烈建议你安排一支<EM4>高度专业的增援部队</EM4>与你一同飞往现场。

如果你能成功捍卫客户利益，我们将向敢于接下此任务的勇敢主承包商支付 <EM4>[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证</EM4>作为奖励。

注意安全，祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保

1mjp8sq.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
We have a special assignment for only the most competent contractors. One of our haulers who is sadly no longer with us failed to complete their last job. The cargo they were supposed to deliver is sitting stationary in their former ship in the location listed below.
RECOVERY LOCATION
· [LOCATION]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
I’m not going dance around the issue, this is an extremely challenging job. You’ll need to bring a strong team of skilled pilots with you to deal with the outlaws that killed the previous contractor and a heavy-duty tractor beam to retrieve the client’s cargo. That said, if you take on this contract, we will make it worth your time.
HOW DID WE DO – Complete our short feedback survey on our Spectrum page for a chance to enter our monthly prize draw.
1mjp8sq.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

我们为最优秀的承包商准备了一项特殊任务。我们的一名运输员不幸遇难，未能完成最后一单任务。他原本要运送的货物，现在仍静静躺在他那艘飞船里，位置如下。

找回地点
     · <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>

卸货地点
     · <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的货运电梯

我不会和你绕弯子，这是一项极其艰巨的任务。你需要带一支实力强劲的飞行员团队，去应对杀死上一位承包商的不法分子，并配备一台<EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>来取回客户的货物。不过，如果你接下这份合约，我们一定会让你觉得值得。

我们做得如何 - 请在我们的光谱页面完成简短的反馈调查，有机会参与我们的月度抽奖。

It feels that whenever we start to make real progress in the system, the outlaws are there to push one step back. We had recently cleared out [LOCATION] only to learn that a new outlaw gang has taken root there, using it as a launching point for various criminal enterprises.

利玛·恩迪科特

d4ipaq.description_en:
Citizens for Prosperity are eager to help the people of Pyro, and it starts with freeing them from the grasp of XenoThreat.
We’re preparing a team to infiltrate one of their outposts, but we need someone to go in ahead to take out their communication towers first. Once those towers are offline, they won’t be able to call for reinforcements and we can proceed with our plan.
Head to [LOCATION] and find the towers. At the top is a control panel that can be used to disable them.
Also, it’s worth noting that most outposts use a similar system, so you’ll know how to disable the comms towers rather than risk fighting reinforcement dropships when you’re doing other jobs.
Good luck,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
d4ipaq.description_zh:
繁荣公民渴望帮助派罗的人民，而这一切都要从把他们从异种威胁的魔爪中解救出来开始。

我们正在准备一支小队渗透进他们的一个前哨站，但需要有人先行潜入摧毁他们的通讯塔。只要那些塔一瘫痪，他们就无法呼叫增援，我们就能顺利推进计划了。

前往 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 找到通讯塔。塔顶有一个控制面板，可以用来关闭它们。

另外，值得注意的是，大多数前哨站都使用类似的系统，所以你会知道如何关闭通讯塔，而不是在执行其他任务时冒险与增援运输船作战。

祝你好运，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

I've got a client who's been messaging me all morning about a shipment they were supposed to receive and when I checked up on the cargo it turns out that it's sitting completely still in the middle of space.

16sossq.description_en:
Hey!
DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.
The UWC offers repair, rearming and refueling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refueling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.
And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.
If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out.
A Club member has run out of [FUELTYPE] at [LOCATION]. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.
The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST]. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their [SHIP] and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a journal entry on your mobiGlas called "Refueling Protocols" that covers the basics.
There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates.
Looking forward to working with you.
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
16sossq.description_zh:
嘿！

我是来自旅者联合俱乐部的 DD。

UWC 在全 UEE 范围内提供维修、补给和加油服务。碰巧我们正在寻找新的合作伙伴，只要你的飞船配备了加油设备。如果你拥有燃料吊舱，并且喜欢被人热情迎接，那么 UWC 可能很适合你来。

如果你觉得这不错，那我手头正好有一个正在运行的信标你可能喜欢。

如果你确实喜欢它，那么给你一个提醒：<EM4>出发前务必确保燃料吊舱已满</EM4>。

一名俱乐部成员在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 那边耗尽了 [FUELTYPE]。具体细节我还不太清楚，比如他们怎么就跑到那儿连“动力果汁”都没了，但 UWC 不想把大家晾在一边不管。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

这是一趟很简单的活儿。如果你想感受熟悉这类工作，这再合适不过了。去那里给他们的 <EM4>[SHIP]</EM4> 加满油，然后让他们启程吧。多做几次这样的任务，操作就会变成肌肉记忆。在此之前，你的 mobiGlas 里有一篇名为“加油协议”的<EM4>日志条目</EM4>，涵盖了所有基础内容。

该区域尚未报告有不法分子活动，但仍需保持警惕。我始终建议你追求快速周转。越早完成，我就越能尽快为你安排下一份合约。UWC 一直在寻找新的合作伙伴。

期待与你合作，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”
